what_happened: Dispatch acceptance bullet says 'Shellcheck clean per context/standards/shell-strict-mode.md', but that standard documents strict-mode classes only and never mentions shellcheck; no repo gate (verify-deploy.sh) runs shellcheck either. Plan adopts an explicit two-part reading (correct strict-mode class + no shellcheck findings on in-scope touched files) and records the out-of-file_scope carry-over rather than leaving the ambiguity to implementation.

run-all.sh --jobs auto --fail-on-new full sweep after Phase 4's known-failures.txt row removal reported 2 NEW failures, both unrelated to this task's file_scope: test-four-tier-conflict.sh (not reproducible in isolation, 13/13 standalone -- timing-threshold assertions, load-sensitive under concurrent host sessions) and test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh (reproducible in isolation: 'baseline fixture is not clean (rc=1, gate20 finding lines=0)' -- a real but out-of-scope defect, likely caused by concurrent in-flight work on commands/orchestrate.md or skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md from other active tasks observed in git status). Neither owned suite (test-lint-json-channel-discipline.sh, test-typst-element-lint.sh) failed or was reclassified.

Phase 5's full gate (verify-deploy.sh, no --skip-slow) initially failed gate 13 (whole-tree orphan detection: 3 pre-existing orphan files from an already-committed, unrelated roadmap-integration.sh quarantine -- commits 9e3b1c5b8/bc2205f0d, confirmed via git log and manifest grep), which self-resolved on a second run minutes later (another concurrent task's cleanup landed). Gate 8 (run-all.sh, no --fail-on-new) then failed with 2 NEW failures that DIFFERED from Phase 4's observation: this time test-lake-build-guard.sh and test-lint-scoped-commit-boundary.sh (neither in this task's file_scope), versus Phase 4's test-four-tier-conflict.sh/test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh. The failing pair changing between runs minutes apart, with neither owned suite (test-chapter-quality-check.sh, test-typst-element-lint.sh, test-lint-json-channel-discipline.sh -- all PASS in both runs) ever appearing, confirms ambient concurrent-session load/activity as the cause, not this task's diff. Also discovered: the typst extension is not, and per git history at HEAD never was, a loaded extension in this repo's own .claude-extensions.json, so there is no deployed typst tree to re-run the typst-specific suites from; the one subject suite that IS deployed (test-lint-json-channel-discipline.sh, core extension) was confirmed green (12/12) from the deployed tree.
